newsitem.title: USA: Solv-Ex says Merrill Lynch sells shrs.
newsitem.headline: Solv-Ex says Merrill Lynch sells shrs.

text.p: Solv-Ex Corp said early Friday that up to 1.1 million shares held by Merrill Lynch in the name of Solv-Ex Chairman John Rendall are to be sold.
The shares are a portion of those that Merrill Lynch received in April to secure a margin loan it extended to Rendall at that time, the company said.

In a news release, Rendall said he was surprised that Merrill Lynch would take these actions so quickly after extending the margin loan since the amount of the loan is "more than adequately covered" by the value of the common stock held by Merrill Lynch.
On Thursday, Solv-Ex stock closed down 1/4 to 7. Its 52-week low is 6 and its high during that period is 28-1/4.
Rendall said in the release that he is reviewing his legal options. Solv-Ex said that it had not consented to the transaction.
To date Merrill Lynch has demanded that Rendall repay about $1,399,000, Solv-Ex said.
